A successful re-synchronization achieves minimal power oscillations in both systems, and it is conducted by measuring the voltage phasor at the utility bus side. A smooth connection is guaranteed when the voltages in both busses are similar in magnitude and phase [39]. Furthermore, the frequency deviation between the two systems must be as small as pos- sible [39,40].
